hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qE '(rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]].*--force)' && { echo 'Blocked: destructive command (rm -rf or git push --force) is not allowed.' >&2; exit 1; } || exit 0

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in worker/*.py|*/worker/*.py) uv run --project worker ruff check --fix "$file" && uv run --project worker pyright "$file" ;; api/*.py|*/api/*.py) uv run --project api ruff check --fix "$file" && uv run --project api pyright "$file" ;; esac
file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$file" in */web/*.ts|*/web/*.tsx) cd "${file%%/web/*}/web" && pnpm tsc --noEmit && pnpm biome check "$file" ;; esac
